name: australian-contract-review
description: Review inbound Australian contracts against controlled playbooks, verified statutory sources and approval thresholds for qualified lawyer review.

interface.shortDescription: Reviews inbound Australian contracts against standard positions, fallbacks and approval thresholds.
interface.longDescription: Configures review playbooks, triages NDAs, reviews commercial agreements, screens ACL and ASIC unfair terms, maps liability and indemnity regimes, prepares negotiation memos and tracks renewals. Keeps future subscription rules separate from current law and requires qualified lawyer review.
defaultPrompt: Create a contract-review playbook from our standard positions, fallbacks and approval thresholds.
Triage this inbound NDA as green, yellow or red against our approved playbook.
Review this MSA and SOW and return a clause-referenced issues table.
Screen these terms for ACL or financial-services unfair-contract-terms risk.
Review how this contract's caps, exclusions, indemnities and insurance interact.
Prepare a negotiation memo with current text, proposed text, rationale and fallbacks.
Build a renewal and notice-date register from these executed contracts.
